name: Siennea
summary: Siennea is defined by contrast and warmth. Its frame, plated in rich yellow copper, glows with a quiet radiance, while the matte surface above introduces a note of calm modernity. The body is enveloped in walnut veneer, its natural grain adding depth and timeless character. Inside, drawers lined in black fabric reveal a hidden softness, elevated by a mirrored detail accented with a delicate band of light. Siennea speaks to contemporary elegance, where structure and intimacy meet in harmonious design.
